test_case: ELMFIRE tutorial01_constant_wind (official Tutorial 01: fire spread in flat terrain under constant wind)

simulation.grid: 400 x 400 cells, 30 m, domain 12 km x 12 km centred on (0,0), EPSG:32610
simulation.weather: constant wind 15 mph from 0 deg; dead moisture 3/4/5 %; live herb 30 %, live woody 60 %
simulation.launcher: official 01-run.sh (GDAL builds constant input rasters, runs ELMFIRE, converts outputs to GeoTIFF, gdal_contour isochrones)
simulation.runtime: about 7 s wall, about 105 MB RAM, single process
